display.purpose: Landing page headline and workspace greeting.

title.purpose: Team cards, member cards, and panels.

label.purpose: Form labels, nav sections, and status badges.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive card lift on pointer hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main commit action across forms and cards.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5425a7; color: #ffffff; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3d1880; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5425a7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Explicit status indicator for Pending, Accepted, and Rejected states.
components.css: .ds-badge-accepted { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; background: #eaf7f0; color: #155e3d; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Accessible form input with 3:1 border contrast.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #24163d; border: 1px solid #c7bad9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #5425a7; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #5425a7; }

narrative.overview: EventMate pairs the warmth and clarity of a student collaboration board with the discipline of an operational directory. Derived from EventMate's existing Brand Refresh identity and logo, the interface anchors itself in deep violet ink and crisp white work surfaces over a faint tinted ground, reserving rose-magenta strictly for primary brand moments and key actions rather than spreading it across every panel.
keyCharacteristics: Solid white operational cards separated by 1px subtle violet-tinted borders rather than stacked drop shadows.
Crisp semantic state badges (Pending, Accepted, Rejected) pairing icon, tint, and high-contrast text.
Consistent 12px control radius and 16px container radius across all screens.
Single-axis brand gradient restricted to the hero banner and membership card.

rules.name: The Brand Restraint Rule
rules.body: Gradients and rose accents appear only on the public entry hero, workspace welcome banner, and membership plan card.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Slot counts, deadlines, and rating averages use tabular-nums so numbers align cleanly.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Resting cards stay flat with a 1px hairline border; shadows indicate active hover or modal layer separation only.

dos: Do verify every foreground/background pair against WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1 normal text, >= 3:1 UI borders and large text).
Do include explicit Loading skeleton, Empty (with next action), and Error (with retry) states on every data page.
Do show shared contact fields only after mutual Accepted membership and never for blocked users.
donts: Don't invent placeholder statistics, fake testimonials, or simulated payment activations.
Don't place decorative glow, backdrop blur on every card, or em dashes in UI copy.
Don't trap keyboard users in modals without Escape close and visible focus rings.
